label: PF Backlog 494
title: DOGFOOD P3: scheduled live dogfood + trend/regression dashboard

delivery.note: Phase 3: schedule cadence (core/dogfood_schedule) + tick/schedule/trends APIs; merge --no-ff (no PR)

brief.problem: Dogfood runs were on-demand only; there was no cadence and no trend/regression view.
brief.what_adds: core/dogfood_schedule.py (single writer of config/dogfood-schedule.json) with a tick that enqueues DUE dogfood runs (idempotent per period) through the Phase 1 runner; POST /dogfood/schedule/tick and GET /dogfood/schedule; GET /dogfood/trends reads validation-runs.json for a series + regression flag.
brief.why: Catch regressions over time automatically, at no CI cost (an external cron triggers the API).

objective: Run the Phase 1 dogfood on a schedule (nightly/pre-release), store results, and surface trends/regression alerts.
acceptance_criteria: scheduler calls POST /dogfood/run on a cadence (nightly/pre-release)
results stored in validation-runs.json (existing owner) + dashboard trends
approach: A schedule config + single-writer module; the tick enqueues via the Phase 1 run_entry (idempotent through last_run); trends is a read model over the existing validation-runs.json. API-first; no daemon; no dashboard coupling.

prior_decisions: One writer/concern; a new concern registers in store-registry
API-first; the legacy dashboard is frozen
existing_path: job_manager one-shot due time not_before (job_manager.py:96-112,144); no cron
assumptions: cadence via external cron -> tick API (no daemon)
schedule is a global config store
divergences: New config store + owner module + endpoints (new path, approved)
open_questions: regression = latest non-PASS following a PASS (chosen)

risks: the schedule config must default disabled to avoid surprise runs
summary: Adds API-first cadence for dogfood and a read-only trends/regression endpoint so dogfood can run on a schedule and be observed over time.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/api_docs.py, core/cross_review.py, core/dashboard_archetypes.py, core/dashboard_blueprint.py

_note: Phase 3 delivered + validated (pytest 16 passed, gate OK, api-governance 147 paths in sync, store-check OK, wired-audit unwired 0, lint 0 NEW)
